name: timestamp_zone
description: Browser-native Unix timestamp ↔ ISO 8601 ↔ multi-timezone converter. All computation in WASM. Privacy-first.

tools.name: convert_unix_timestamp
tools.description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds, auto-detected) to multiple formats including ISO 8601, RFC 2822, RFC 3339, and optional custom strftime format. Optionally convert to a target timezone.

unix_value.description: Unix timestamp value. Auto-detected as seconds or milliseconds (> 10000000000000 is treated as ms).

timezone_offset_hours.description: Target timezone offset hours (e.g. 8 for Asia/Shanghai).

timezone_offset_minutes.description: Target timezone offset minutes (e.g. 30 for Asia/Kolkata).

tools.name: convert_iso8601
tools.description: Convert an ISO 8601 time string to Unix timestamps (seconds and milliseconds). Supports formats like '2026-08-06T16:30:00Z', '2026-08-06T16:30:00+08:00', '2026-08-06T16:30:00', and '2026-08-06'.

tools.name: get_common_timezones
tools.description: Get a list of common timezone definitions including name, UTC offset hours/minutes, and abbreviation.

tools.name: calculate_duration
tools.description: Calculate the precise duration between two Unix timestamps (in seconds). Returns total seconds, days/hours/minutes/seconds breakdown, and a human-readable string.
